annotations.title: US meat and poultry recalls search (paid)

description: PAID, per call: search the U.S. Department of Agriculture Food Safety and Inspection Service's published meat, poultry and egg product recalls and public health alerts by keyword, establishment, state, recall number, type and date (give at least one). Returns up to 10 rows with the dates of the data and the FSIS address of each notice. No consumer instructions or images. Not an official notice. You are not charged when nothing matches or when the data is out of date.

keyword.description: Words to find in the title, establishment, reason and products. Every word must appear.

recall_number.description: The FSIS recall number exactly as published.

recall_type.description: The notice type as published, for example Recall or Public Health Alert.

since.description: Notice date on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

state.description: A state as the notice publishes it, for example California.

name: search_us_meat_poultry_recalls
